Container.Name: Brickfolio
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted PWA for scanning, managing and valuing a LEGO collection - built for a whole family sharing one database, with an optional collector mode for people who buy and sell at flea markets.
Photo to recognition to collection: photograph a minifigure or set with your phone, tap the match, done. Recognition uses the free Brickognize API; names, prices and set contents come from Rebrickable and BrickLink (your own free API keys, entered in a setup wizard on first start - the app also works without them, just without prices and name search).
Features: camera scanning and catalogue search, quantities and condition, BrickLink average prices with your own price history and charts, wishlist, shopping lists for flea markets with proportional offer splitting, duplicates/sell list, statistics, CSV export and print lists, multi-user with roles, JSON backup, three themes, installable as a PWA. Optionally several instances can connect to a small trading hub to swap items, with end-to-end encrypted messages.
Everything stays on your server - no cloud, no third-party account. The database lives in the /data path below.
LEGO is a trademark of the LEGO Group, which does not sponsor, authorise or endorse this project. Private hobby project, no commercial intent.

Config.Name: Port: Web Interface
Config.Description: Web interface. Open it once after starting - a setup wizard walks you through the admin account and the API keys.

Config.Name: Path: /data
Config.Description: Database, automatic backups and uploaded images. This is the only folder that matters - keep it, everything else is replaceable.

Config.Name: Admin user (optional)
Config.Description: Only for unattended setups: creates the admin account on first start and skips the wizard. Leave empty to set it up in the browser.

Config.Name: Admin password (optional)
Config.Description: Password for the account above. Leave empty to set it up in the browser.

Config.Name: Rebrickable API key (optional)
Config.Description: Catalogue search by name. Free key from rebrickable.com/api - can also be entered in the app later (More - API keys).

Config.Name: BrickLink Consumer Key (optional)
Config.Description: Prices and set contents. All four BrickLink values belong together - see bricklink.com/v2/api/register_consumer.page. Can also be entered in the app later.

Config.Name: Keep daily backups
Config.Description: How many automatic daily database backups to keep in /data. 0 turns them off.
